translationRepairs: On guichou Khitan envoys led by Nako Meri came with tribute to claim Tu Nei's bones after his beheading at the north market.
On guichou Khitan envoys led by Nako Meri came with tribute claiming to take Tu Nei's bones, and they were beheaded at the north market.
並斬於北市 follows the envoy arrival and pretext clause, so the envoys (捺括梅裏等) are the ones beheaded; the before text wrongly treats 斬 as Tu Nei's earlier death.
On renchen Chen Gao became Wuxing commissioner and Zhai Zhang Weisai commissioner.
On dinghai Chen Gao became Wuxing commissioner and Zhai Zhang Weisai commissioner.
The unit opens 丁亥 (dinghai); renchen is the following day 壬辰 in s0062, so the idiomatic date must be corrected.

On renchen, Feng prefecture Wuxing Army acting regent Chen Gao was made Wuxing Army military commissioner; Xin prefecture Weisai Army acting regent Zhai Zhang was made Weisai Army military commissioner.

On dinghai, Feng prefecture Wuxing Army acting regent Chen Gao was made Wuxing Army military commissioner; Xin prefecture Weisai Army acting regent Zhai Zhang was made Weisai Army military commissioner.
Literal likewise misreads 丁亥 as renchen; dinghai matches the Chinese day name.

On jiachen Feng Dao became southern suburban chief ritualist; Lu Zhi of War, ritualist; Xu Guangyi, censor-in-chief, equipage master; Yao Yan of War, halberd master; Congrong of Henan, bridge and relay master; Zhang Zunhui, guest commissioner and Court of the Imperial Clan director, repair and regalia master.

On jiachen Feng Dao became southern suburban chief ritualist; Lu Zhi of War, ritualist; Xu Guangyi, censor-in-chief, equipage master; Yao Yi of War, halberd master; Congrong of Henan, bridge and relay master; Zhang Zunhui, guest commissioner and Court of the Imperial Clan director, repair and regalia master.
姚顗 is Yao Yi (顗 = yǐ); Yao Yan is wrong, and the proposed Yao Hui is also an incorrect romanization of the same graph.
On guiwei Yu Qiao, secretariat vice director, was matched to a Zhenwu long exile and barred forever—Zhao Feng's false memorial.
On guiwei Yu Qiao, secretariat vice director, was sentenced to long exile as a commoner at Zhenwu and barred from office forever—Zhao Feng's false memorial.
配振武長流百姓 is a legal sentence to long exile as a commoner at Zhenwu, and 永不齒任 bars office forever; the before phrasing obscures both.
(The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 says supervising compiler Zhao Feng and compilers Zhang Zhaoyuan and Lü Xianxiu each received silks, silver vessels, and the like.)〉
(The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 says supervising compiler Zhao Feng and compilers Zhang Zhaoyuan and Lü Xianxiu each received silks, silver vessels, and the like.)
The trailing 〉 is residue from the Chinese annotation brackets 〈…〉 and is not part of the English gloss.
